name: freebuff
tagline: Five genuinely free AI coding products with no API keys
description: freebuff bundles five free AI coding products from Codebuff: a desktop app with parallel agents, a CLI, a web app for full-stack projects, a cloud service that works from any GitHub repo, and a chat interface. It runs a multi-agent architecture with specialized agents rather than one model doing everything, powered by DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiniMax M3, and MiMo 2.5. There are no subscriptions, credits, or API keys — the model is supported by text ads, and it works in every country.
highlights: Five products — desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat — under one free umbrella
No subscription, credits, or API keys; supported by text ads
Multi-agent architecture with specialized agents instead of one model
Runs DeepSeek V4, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiniMax M3, and MiMo 2.5
Cloud mode works directly from any GitHub repo
curatorNote: Free AI coding tools usually mean a stingy free tier. freebuff's bet — genuinely free everywhere, supported by text ads — is worth watching, and the specialized multi-agent architecture is a better design than most paid products.
